entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate small trophy object modeling sheet.
Subject: ONE EAR TROPHY SORCERER, item.design.dynamic.ear-sorcerer, cursor19. PRIVATE original sprite only silhouette/proportion/local-color reference. Reconstruct the small isolated ear-shaped old trophy with a narrow upright oval outline, deeply folded dark ochre-brown leathery surface/cartilage, dark inner fold, slightly tapered lower lobe, tiny dull silver-gray hook/earring dangling at the lower lobe. Preserve original dry muted brown and silver palette. This is a restrained old game item, not fresh injury. No blood drops, wound detail, flesh cross-section or body/head; the rear attachment surface remains dry and unobtrusive. Tiny dark reddish source region treated as dry discoloration, no gore.
Five distinct views of SAME complete object: FRONT visible ear folds, true thin SIDE thickness, BACK true smooth convex reverse of cartilage (not a repeated concave front), full-size THREE-QUARTER and separate small new HD INVENTORY preview. Same size, earring attachment and outer silhouette throughout, reverse correctly mirrors asymmetry. No combined oblique/thumbnail. Hidden rear and depth conservative inference.
Realistic worn dry leather-like organic material and dull metal, opaque charcoal-gray backdrop, neutral soft WHITE studio light. Labels only EAR TROPHY - SORCERER / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON. No hands, character, scenery, chains or added skulls, magic, glow or watermark. Never paste, trace or display source pixels; ICON newly rendered HD from this same candidate.
entries.notes: Outer silhouette, source local colors, class-specific metal fitting/no fitting and true convex rear visually inspected. Rear contour, thickness, organic material and exact fitting construction inferred; small red source region treated as dry discoloration. Three-quarter weakly oblique. Native class bits/name metadata remain unchanged. New HD thumbnail is a candidate preview, not runtime art.
